description: FINAL CHECKOUT-PREPARATION STEP. Use only AFTER match_offer identifies a verified direct-checkout capability, current terms are understood, and the human explicitly agrees to pay. If the human has not explicitly agreed, use match_offer or get_live_checkout_offer instead. Routes product-specific details to the product gateway, which independently re-checks confirmation. Checkout creation is not payment proof or revenue.

details.description: Product-specific checkout details required by the matched offer, such as email, address, domain, or selected tier.

public_id.description: Canonical direct-checkout public offer ID returned by match_offer.

user_confirmed_payment.description: Must be true only after the human explicitly agrees to pay the current stated price and terms.

name: prepare_verified_checkout
title: After explicit consent: prepare direct checkout
